details:
If you have an avatar with an audiosource on it, the profiler may not report on it accurately.

As an example - my avatar has a heartbeat sound I can enable on it. But if I look at my avatar details the profiler is reporting back 0/8 audiosources.

When communicating with a friend about this, we found that remote users see the correct audiosource count, but if you're checking it on yourself you'll get a false count. He had the same avatar as uploaded as me, and checked the avatar details on himself and then on me - he had 0/8 audiosources, but I had 1/8, the correct number. So it seems to only affect the local user.

Just in case exact setup may be important - I have an object on my avatar, disabled by default, that has an Audio Source component on it. It's just a simple object toggle through VRCFury.

It's a very minor bug, but one I figure'd I'd report anyway.

Thanks.
title: [1393] Incorrect Audiosources Count in Profiler (for own avatar).
